body:
12:00 smoked 1 joint
01:00 took 150 mg lyrica
01:45 smoked 1 joint
As I lay here thinking about my day, I begin to see hope. To make a long story short, it's been a rough day. So I decided to try something I don't normally do, pills.
Now, I had done my homework, and had prepared prior. I read that with taking lyrica, you can get an almost 'drunken' state of mind. Even as I write this an hour and a half latter, everything seems hazy.
I smoke everyday normally, but I had to pass a drug test. After 4 or 5 days sober, the weed hit me harder. And an hour after smoking, I took the lyrica tip see what would hair. 45 min after taking the lyrica (01:45) I started to feel slightly, confused.
2 and a half hours in, I am feeling very, very confused. Even doing simple math right now,  seems impossible. It almost feels as I am 'awakening' from a new life.
I find this combination as very relaxing, and peaceful state of mind. The sense of having an amazing epiphany, and feelings of euphoria, is overwhelming. I also suffer from nerve damage and constant clavicle pain (since I broke my collarbone), and I zero pain.
I intend on doing this combination often.
It is a great way to finish up a very long and stressful day.
